title: Merged PDF Sections in the Wrong Order? Check the Boundaries
description: Plan PDF section order before merging on iPhone, then check boundary pages and total page counts in the saved copy before sharing.
direct: Before merging PDF sections, decide their sequence and check every join in the exported file. A correct file list does not prove that the pages inside each source are also in order.
figureAlt: Three fictional PDF sections labeled 01 Form, 02 Notes and 03 Appendix.
figureCaption: AI-generated conceptual illustration, not an App screenshot, measured result or real export.
cards.choice.heading: Plan the section boundaries
cards.choice.body: Write down the source sequence and expected page counts. If names are sorted as text, 10 can appear before 2; use clear names such as 01, 02 and 03 to reduce ambiguity. Renaming alone does not prove the merge tool uses filename order.
sections.explain.heading: Distinguish two kinds of disorder
sections.explain.body: If whole sections are misplaced, correct the input sequence and merge again. If a source scan already has internal pages out of order, correct that source with an appropriate page-editing workflow first. Do not assume this app includes an unlisted page-reordering or OCR tool.
sections.practice.heading: Check a small sample first
sections.practice.body: Space Sheep Studio develops this iPhone PDF toolkit. Its current listing includes merging, scanning, signing and compression. Any export tool can be tried once free; further exports require Pro. Start with two short sample PDFs to verify the actual ordering behavior before assembling a long manual. Preserve digitally signed originals because merging can affect signature validation. The illustration shows document organization, not a real export or performance test.
sources.store.label: PDF Compressor: Sign & Merge 1.3.3: current iPhone features
related.related.label: Related practical guide
steps.step-1.text: Open the merge tool in PDF Compressor: Sign & Merge and select the intended source documents. Check the presented sequence before exporting.
steps.step-2.text: Create a separate merged copy. Keep all source PDFs while checking that the output contains every expected section.
steps.step-3.text: Open the saved PDF. Inspect the last page of each section and the first page of the next, then compare the total page count with your notes.
